question: After the pacing defect is fixed, should OpenClaw keep ambiguous no-reconciler outbound rows pending/recoverable instead of moving them to failed?
rationale: That choice affects upgrade behavior and message-delivery operations: it preserves future reconciliation but can leave durable pending rows visible until a reconciler or operator flow exists.

options.title: Accept pending deferral after repair
options.body: Fix the replay-pacing bug, then land the recoverable pending semantics as a narrow mitigation while the broader delivery-ledger issue stays open.

options.title: Keep terminal failure behavior
options.body: Close or replace this PR and keep current main's fail-closed behavior until the broader delivery-reconciliation design is ready.

options.title: Require broader ledger first
options.body: Pause this PR and handle recoverability only as part of the transcript-to-client delivery ledger and UI/API surfacing work.

recommendation.title: Accept pending deferral after repair
recommendation.body: Fix the replay-pacing bug, then land the recoverable pending semantics as a narrow mitigation while the broader delivery-ledger issue stays open.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history and blame put this person closest to the current outbound recovery and adapter contract surfaces.
